_comment: Places for the CRM's IDX place catalog (src/lib/idx/places-catalog.ts), one per homes strip on the batch 2026-10-b pages (tools/glass.js homes(); website-patches/idx-strips.patch). 'pages' lists where each strip appears. Match rules are drafts: confirm each subdivision name against the MLS feed before going live. Never invent a map point; the strips need no point. Round 15 (contract v1): each place has the search it runs: subdivision words, or near a point with miles. Confirm each against the MLS on day one. Contract v1 hoa=0 (CRM ticket 415, 22 Oct 2026): the no-HOA places search only homes whose listing says there is no HOA; every such strip and page says where that fact comes from.
